subject: TERMINATE statement
notes: kb/Work PB326, landed. 'The TERMINATE statement may be executed only for a report that is in the active state. If the report is not in the active state, the EC-REPORT-INACTIVE exception condition is set to exist and the execution of the statement is unsuccessful.' Two goldens reach it from two directions: a second TERMINATE after a successful one, and a TERMINATE after an INITIATE that §14.9.21.4 GR3 refused (which is also the witness that GR3 took no action on the report). kb/Work PB688 (2026-09-05): the golden moved from tests/conformance/2002 to tests/conformance/2023 - it observes the report by re-reading the report file through ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL, which is a COBOL-2023 introduction (12.4.5.10.3 GR2; the Foreword's main-changes list over ISO/IEC 1989:2014), so the program is not expressible at 2002. The RULE's editions are unchanged.
